{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
clean_mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Final check: confirm no QA orders remain
assert len(df_clean[df_clean['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]) == 0, "QA orders were not fully filtered"

# Output the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {clean_mean_revenue}")"}
